title: Maternal Hemodynamic Profiling Protocol
author: Wilfried Gyselaers
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tffejjn
materials: Hepatic and Renal venous ECG-Doppler Ultrasound

steps.title: Perform bioelectrical impedance analysis
steps.instruction: With the participant lying supine, arms and legs stretched and without socks or shoes, place two receiving electrodes on the dorsal surfaces of the wrist and ankle at the radial/ulnar and fibular/tibial bone levels, and two sending electrodes on the third metacarpal of the right hand and the right foot; set the Maltron Bioscan 920‑II to deliver 0.6 mA at 5, 50, 100 and 200 kHz for 5 seconds, then record total body water (TBW) and its intracellular (ICW) and extracellular (ECW) components.

steps.title: Conduct uterine and venous Doppler ultrasound
steps.instruction: Using a 3.5 MHz transabdominal probe (Aplio Mx, Toshiba) in supine position with interrupted breathing, first locate the uterine arcuate arteries < 2 cm from the intra‑uterine branch insertion and, with the scanner’s automated algorithm, measure Resistivity Index (RI) and Pulsatility Index (PI) three consecutive times on each side and average them; then place ECG leads, acquire Doppler waveforms from the renal interlobar and hepatic veins, measure each parameter (including heart‑rate‑corrected pulse transit time and venous impedance index) three consecutive times and average, calculating VPT as the interval between the ECG P‑top and Doppler A‑wave (ms) and also as a fraction of the R‑R interval, and computing the venous impedance index as (max velocity – min velocity) / max velocity.

steps.title: Measure standing blood pressure
steps.instruction: Ask the participant to stand, wait three minutes for postural adaptation, then place an appropriately sized cuff on the right brachial artery of the automated sphygmomanometer integrated in the impedance‑cardiography device; record systolic, diastolic and mean arterial pressures (SBP, DBP, MAP) – only the standing values will be used for analysis.

steps.title: Record impedance cardiography parameters
steps.instruction: After the standing blood pressure measurement, allow a one‑minute interval, then attach four skin‑resistance‑eliminating electrodes (two on the axillary line under the thorax and two on the neck) for the NICCOMO (Medis) system; let cardiovascular function stabilize for three minutes in the standing position, then acquire heart rate (HR), stroke volume (SV) (calculated with the Bernstein formula), cardiac output (CO = HR × SV), velocity index (VI), acceleration index (ACI), and compute total peripheral resistance (TPR = MAP × 80 / CO).

description: An independent t-test at 5% significance level was used for intergroup comparison of continuous demographic data. Chi-square test was used for categorical demographic variables. Normality was checked via Shapiro-Wilk. Data were presented as mean ± SD or n (%).
